characters.description: The Dragon Reborn, a young man from the Two Rivers fated to face the Dark One at the Last Battle. He wields the male One Power, and has lately done what all believed impossible, cleansing saidin of the Dark One's ancient taint so that men may channel without going mad, though few yet accept it is true. Feared and hunted, he has bound the Aiel to him, taken thrones, and killed several of the Forsaken, growing colder and warier as the war grinds on and enemies press on every side.
characters.name: Rand al'Thor

characters.description: A ta'veren gambler and reluctant hero from the Two Rivers, lucky beyond reason, carrying the memories of dead generals and a medallion that turns aside the One Power. Having escaped Seanchan-held Ebou Dar, he is now on the run in the north, hiding among a traveling menagerie show while warily keeping company with Tuon, the Seanchan heir he carried off, whom prophecy says he must marry.
characters.name: Mat Cauthon

characters.description: A blacksmith and wolfbrother from the Two Rivers, a reluctant battle lord able to speak with wolves. Consumed by the need to free his wife, Faile, from the Shaido Aiel who hold her captive, he has grown grim and single-minded, willing to consider bargains and measures he once would have refused in order to get her back.
characters.name: Perrin Aybara

characters.description: The young Amyrlin Seat of the rebel Aes Sedai, an innkeeper's daughter of surprising strength and discipline. Underestimated by the sisters who raised her to be a figurehead, she has instead taken real command of the army besieging Tar Valon, determined to bring down the usurping Amyrlin, Elaida, and reunite the divided White Tower.
characters.name: Egwene al'Vere

characters.description: The former Wisdom of Emond's Field, now an Aes Sedai and wife to Lan, fierce, stubborn, and a gifted Healer. She stood at the heart of Rand's cleansing of saidin and remains one of the few who will speak plainly to the Dragon Reborn, impatient with the schemes of the sisters gathered around him.
characters.name: Nynaeve al'Meara

characters.description: The Daughter-Heir of Andor and an Aes Sedai, one of the women bound to Rand, working from Caemlyn to win the Lion Throne that is hers by right. Proud and politically shrewd, she contends with rival claimants and hidden enemies for the crown while the realm teeters on civil war.
characters.name: Elayne Trakand

characters.description: A practical, sharp-tongued young woman who reads the future in the auras she alone can see around people. One of the three women fated to love Rand, she stays close at his side as confidante and adviser, watching the dangers gathering around him.
characters.name: Min Farshaw

characters.description: A fierce Aiel woman and Wise One apprentice, once a warrior, now learning to channel and to lead among her people. Proud and rigidly honest, bound by Aiel custom, she is one of the three women tied to Rand by love and prophecy.
characters.name: Aviendha

characters.description: A legendary and formidable Aes Sedai, long thought dead, who has taken it upon herself to guide the Dragon Reborn. Imperious and secretive, celebrated for her skill in dealing with men who can channel, she means to teach Rand what she believes he must learn before the Last Battle, whether he wishes it or not.
characters.name: Cadsuane Melaidhrin

characters.description: The Daughter of the Nine Moons and heir to the Seanchan Crystal Throne, a small, composed, and dangerous young woman schooled in a ruthless court. Carried off from Ebou Dar by Mat Cauthon, she now travels with him, watchful and unbowed, aware that prophecy binds their fates together even as their peoples are at war.
characters.name: Tuon

characters.description: Perrin's wife, a bold Saldaean noblewoman with a fierce temper, held captive among the Shaido Aiel far from her husband. Proud and resourceful, she works from within her captivity to survive and to resist, while Perrin drives himself to reach her.
characters.name: Faile Bashere
